scripts.gen: bun run --cwd apps/helper openapi && bun run --cwd apps/plugin gen
scripts.typecheck: bun run gen && bun run --cwd apps/helper typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/plugin typecheck && tsc -p packaging/tsconfig.json && tsc -p testing/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: bun run gen && bun run --cwd apps/plugin build && bun run --cwd apps/helper build
scripts.pack:npm: bun run gen && bun run --cwd apps/plugin build && FONT_SYNC_PUBLIC_BUILD=1 bun --no-env-file apps/helper/scripts/build.ts && bun apps/helper/scripts/pack-npm.ts
